This part of the manual explains why careful work counts
Companion Animal Travel Desk Service Handling
This section covers how desk staff manage animal travel requests, check paperwork, and keep the handoff calm and clear for passengers and operations.

At the desk, staff greet each traveler in a steady manner, confirm the animal's booking, and compare the crate and carrier details against the reservation notes. Staff record any service change in the desk ledger and pass concerns to the senior coordinator without delay. If a traveler arrives with a bird, <<FACT F065>> and the clerk should continue with the rest of the acceptance check in a calm and orderly way. If the animal, crate, or documents do not match, staff should pause the process, explain the issue in simple terms, and move the case to review instead of guessing or making a quick exception.

When handling the animal, staff keep voices low, leave space around the crate, and avoid sudden movement that could unsettle the pet. Passengers may be asked to remove loose items from the carrier area, and staff should keep the counter clear so the inspection stays smooth. For any unusual behavior, missing paper, or change in travel condition, the desk follows a calm stepwise review and notes every action taken. The team should never promise a boarding result before the review is complete, and they should avoid back-and-forth talk that slows the line.

If a case needs more help, contact the senior coordinator or the duty supervisor at Aurelia Skyways right away.
